title: Workplace Culture: Driving Innovation or Holding You Back
discussion_signal: The discussion treats workplace culture as an operating condition shaping collaboration, innovation, career growth, decision rights, and organizational performance rather than as a soft value statement.
linked_research_question: How is workplace culture becoming a measurable operating system of strategy, decision rights, and relationships?
limits: The post summarizes a workplace culture report without full comparative data
Employer framing may underrepresent worker disagreement or power asymmetry
Culture types do not themselves establish causal performance effects
